system.story: No academy, no company - you learned to fight staying alive in the sprawl. Unorthodox, hard to read, meaner than your file suggests.

description.value:
Origin: Street-vet. Nobody trained you but the Flats. You survive because you read a room before it turns, and you never freeze.

Gutter Instinct

Once per encounter, when you would be hit, you may convert it to a glancing / Tier-3 result and gain 2 Adrenaline. In addition, you cannot be surprised while aware of any threat (echoes the Changer's Instinctive Response).

Signature tweak

Controlled Pair gains an edge against any target that has not yet acted this encounter (the ambush instinct).

Bonus skill & contact

Choose Stealth or Intimidation, and gain a street/ganger contact plus a street-doc connection.

Chrome flavor

Scavenged, illegal, over-clocked back-alley chrome - high output, ripperdoc-installed, characterful. (Benchmark numbers; tuned in the numeric pass.)
